tools.name: verify_business
tools.description:
Is this business registered in Illinois, and is it still active? Illinois only.
Inputs: name (2-200 chars), state (IL or Illinois), optional city (max 100), optional zip (5 digits or ZIP+4).
Price: $0.02 per call, paid per call with x402. A monthly API key also works (one unit per call). Call covera

tools.name: verify_batch
tools.description:
The same status check as verify_business for 1 to 100 Illinois businesses in one call. Use it for lead lists. A bad item returns an error object in its own slot and is not counted; a batch with no valid item is refused and costs nothing.
Inputs: businesses, an array of {name, state, optional city, o

tools.name: new_filings
tools.description:
Which businesses newly registered in one Illinois county? Newest first, from the Secretary of State files (plus Will County assumed-name filings).
Inputs: county (required, one county per call, e.g. Will or DuPage), optional industry (text matched against industry_guess), optional since (YYYY-MM-DD,

tools.name: coverage
tools.description:
Free. Call this first to see what is covered before paying: data sources and how fresh they are, the 102 Illinois counties with record counts, the verdict and county_source meanings, known gaps, prices, and how to authenticate or pay (including this MCP endpoint).
Inputs: none. Price: free, no key n

tools.name: health
tools.description:
Free. Is the service up, and how fresh is each data source? status is ok, or stale when a source is older than its threshold.
Inputs: none. Price: free, no key needed.
Example call: {}
